name: Danganronpa V4 Rocky Restarts
source:
16 people with Ultimate talents find themselves waking up at a mysterious camp. Things quickly take a turn for the worst as they find out they're not having a fun summer away from home, they're apart of a strange new killing game.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DanganronpaRR/429373]Game Jolt[/url]]
translation:
16名拥有“超高校级”才能的人醒来发现自己身处一座神秘的营地。当他们意识到自己并非在离家度过愉快的夏日假期，而是被卷入了一场诡异的全新自相残杀游戏时，事态迅速急转直下。

[引自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DanganronpaRR/429373]Game Jolt[/url]]
